environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) deployed in us-east-1 with execution role 'webhook-processor-role' that has DynamoDB write access and broad IAM permissions (iam:CreateUser, iam:AttachUserPolicy). Lambda is in a VPC with NAT gateway but no restrictions on outbound DNS or HTTP to 169.254.169.254. IMDSv1 is accessible from within the Lambda execution environment. No permission boundaries applied to the execution role.
